prompt: The hand-folded carton springs open. What should the worker do?
promptZh: 手摺的紙箱彈開了。同仁應該怎麼做？

options.text: Keep an unused blank from the same stack for review
options.zh: 從同一疊取一張尚未使用的紙箱坯留待檢查
options.whyZh: 手摺後也彈開，就要從同一疊保留尚未成形的紙箱坯，供材料小組檢查。

options.text: Ask the line lead to watch a machine cycle instead
options.zh: 改請產線組長觀察機器的下一個運轉循環。
options.whyZh: 手摺後摺邊維持閉合時，才請產線組長觀察下一個機器循環。

options.text: Put the carton back into the machine immediately
options.zh: 立刻把紙箱放回成形機
options.whyZh: 流程要求留一張紙箱坯，不是把試過的紙箱放回機器。

options.text: Send the whole stack directly to shipping
options.zh: 把整疊直接送到出貨區
options.whyZh: 材料小組要先看紙箱坯；沒有要求送去出貨。

explanationZh: 手摺後也彈開，就要從同一疊保留尚未成形的紙箱坯，供材料小組檢查。
evidence: If the edge springs open, keep a flat blank from the same stack for the materials team.

evidenceSpans.speaker: Narrator
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If the edge springs open, keep a flat blank from the same stack for the materials team.
